new_result.statement: For A=[[B,W],[W^T,C]] and D=diag(B,C), if A has p eigenvalues >=1 and q eigenvalues <=-1, then for every r>=0 D has at least max(p-r,0) eigenvalues >=1-s_{r+1}(W) and at least max(q-r,0) eigenvalues <=-(1-s_{r+1}(W)). Applied to the live global W with r=1, either s2(W)<1/2 and the physical same-side principal blocks retain signed target spectrum at scale 1/2, or s2(W)>=1/2. In the latter branch E3(W)>=dist_F(W,rank<=2)^2/16, so an unpaid state has dist_F(W,rank<=2)<2^-16 and the full law is paid by <541 otherwise.
